requirement: Section 12/13: before Pass A, deterministically determine COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE / DEPENDENCY_EXPANDED_SOURCE / TRUNCATED_SOURCE / STRUCTURALLY_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE / UNKNOWN_SOURCE_COMPLETENESS per unit; known-truncated source must never allow semantic COMPLETE; do not solve by raising limits globally; use structural boundaries and recursive dependency retrieval; preserve provenance for every expanded region.

completenessDetermination.nodeAnchoredUnit: When the operative window is anchored to a real structural node and its absolute offset is known: TRUNCATED_SOURCE iff the window ends before the node's own charEnd and the omitted tail contains non-whitespace text (the A1/B3 shape: a fixed 5,200-char window inside a definition/section that continues). STRUCTURALLY_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE iff the anchor exists but has no text in the index.
completenessDetermination.definitionProseUnit: When the window is not node-anchored but the document text is available: the definition spans from the structural definitions index (declaration start of each '"Term" means') bound the unit; the last definition starting inside the window is the unit whose end is checked - TRUNCATED_SOURCE iff the window ends before that definition's end (the next declaration's start) with non-whitespace text omitted.
completenessDetermination.wholeDocumentUnit: When the operative text IS the entire supplied document (e.g. a whole excerpt file), completeness is known and COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE applies.
completenessDetermination.otherwise: UNKNOWN_SOURCE_COMPLETENESS with an explicit reason - never silently COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE.

explicitCrossReferenceExpansion.sources: (1) the anchoring node's own detected references (structural-references.ts, including descendants) - already resolved/ambiguous/unresolved per physical occurrence; (2) absolute 'Section N.NN(...)' / '§ N.NN(...)' strings in the operative text (for definition-prose windows with no anchor).
explicitCrossReferenceExpansion.resolution: reference-resolver.ts: strip a leading Section/§/Article/Clause label on the query side; exact unique match => UNIQUE; multiple occurrences where exactly one is substantive (has children or >=200 chars of text) and the rest are heading-only (table-of-contents entries) => UNIQUE_AFTER_DEGENERATE_EXCLUSION with the excluded occurrences listed; an inline sub-clause that is not its own node ('6.01(b)(iii)') => RESOLVED_VIA_ENCLOSING_NODE ('6.01(b)') with an explicit note; two substantive occurrences => AMBIGUOUS (never guessed, surfaced to Pass A as an unresolved reference and to the compiler as REVIEW).
explicitCrossReferenceExpansion.bounds: budgetChars 24,000 total (default), 6,000 per expansion region; regions already inside the operative window, the anchor's own ancestors, and duplicates are skipped; once the budget is spent, remaining targets are recorded OUT_OF_SCOPE (disclosed, never silently dropped).
explicitCrossReferenceExpansion.provenance: every expansion region carries documentId, sourceNodeId, sectionRef, charStart, charEnd, the exact referenceText that justified it, and the resolution status/note; truncatedAtBudget is flagged per region.

stateOrdering: TRUNCATED_SOURCE > STRUCTURALLY_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE > UNKNOWN_SOURCE_COMPLETENESS > DEPENDENCY_EXPANDED_SOURCE > COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE (a truncated unit stays truncated no matter how many expansions were retrieved).
compilerEffect: compile.ts adds failureReason SOURCE_CONTEXT_TRUNCATED when the state is TRUNCATED_SOURCE or STRUCTURALLY_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE (existing determineStatus machinery => at least REVIEW_REQUIRED, never COMPLETED); Pass C's semanticallyComplete additionally requires the state to be COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE or DEPENDENCY_EXPANDED_SOURCE.
whyNotAGlobalWindowIncrease: The DSGR trace (06) shows Phase 2D's 40,000-char budget already starves explicit cross-references behind definition chains; the failure is what gets prioritized, not how much is allowed. This layer supplies the unit Section 13 names (provision + explicit cross-references, with definitions still coming from Phase 2D/tools), bounded, with provenance.
relationshipToPhase2D: Additive. context-retrieval/pipeline.ts is unchanged; the compiler still receives the Phase 2D bundle. The source-context result is attached to the compiler input path (compile.ts) and rendered to Pass A and Pass B as labelled regions.
